summary: Feed c023_nic_broker is severely degraded: BROKER-A port 5 to NDR is saturated at 100% of 10 Gbps (bursts higher) discarding 45.81% (90,589,260 pkts) and NDR eth1 is also overrun discarding 1.92% (2,059,140 pkts). NDR is missing ~47% of traffic.

findings.root_cause: Egress oversubscription at BROKER-A port 5 to NDR: average load at 100% of 10 Gbps with bursts exceeding line rate, causing 90,589,260 output discards (45.81% loss). Downstream NDR eth1 also cannot keep up and discards 2,059,140 received packets (1.92% loss).
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR misses nearly half of packets/flows; bidirectional flow reassembly fails, detections and alerts are missed, attacker activity can evade, and forensics/hunting is incomplete. Even packets that egress the broker are subsequently dropped at the tool NIC.

params.solution: create load-balance group across 2+ NDR interfaces/nodes with 5-tuple hashing to preserve flow coherence, or upgrade egress to 25/40/100G LAG

recommended_fix.why: Distributes sustained >10G plus burst load across multiple capture interfaces, eliminating broker egress tail drops and bringing per-interface rate below NDR capture capacity. Preserves NDR requirements for both directions and full payload, unlike slicing which would break detection.
